notes.title: Stealth and Horror games now go into Ninja mode when hit
notes.content:
[p]They go invisible until they prepare their next hit.
I really feel sorry for the people who have a lot of Horror games :|

This might need a nerf, let me know. I'll keep it on Playtest for a few days.[/p][p][/p][p]A Demonstration of this new enemy ability is here: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yfdjzMt2K5w"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Performance Hotfix
notes.content: The last patch halved the FPS, sorry! Fixed now, my bad.

notes.title: Top 3 Tags now show up on enemies
notes.content: [p]This is in prep for unique abilities based on tags, more to come soon![/p][p][/p][p]p.s. I love the fact that the primary tag (selected by Steam users) for 'Getting Over It' is "Psychological Horror'[/p]

notes.title: Volume Settings!
notes.content: Let me know how the default levels are, but you can finally change it yourself

notes.title: Freeze time Ability! Check out your games in the middle of battle
notes.content:
If your power meter is at halfway, you can press shift (or B / Circle for controllers) and stay in matrix mode until you attack.

Because why not? it's so damn cool.

Other changes:
- Disabled attack while your dead so your corpse doesn't go crazy while it is Ragdolling
- All explosion rubble is now removed as soon as you die, to help out lower end video cards.

notes.title: Added some unique enemy abilities
notes.content:
[p]- Games with a genre of Simulation now wear a Hardhat and are immune to keyboard attacks [/p][p]- Games with a genre of Strategy now wear a Military hat and are immune to mouse arrows [/p][p]- Fromsoft games now drop a Bonfire, you can heal over time by standing near it [/p][p]- Valve games carry a crowbar (but it doesn't do anything yet)[/p][p]
Other changes:
- Increased powerup charge rate significantly
- Added voices for smaller enemies
- Added voices for when enemies are immune to damage[/p]

notes.title: Cel Shading makes the game look much better!
notes.content: [p]Let me know if there's much of a performance loss for lower end video cards, before I deploy on the demo build![/p][p][/p][p]I like the look, what do you guys think?[/p]

notes.title: Enemies are now significantly faster
notes.content: [p]Also there's now announcements from the commentary box each time you restart after dying :)[/p]

notes.title: Cleared share list status - Added confirmation box when setting list to shared
notes.content:
There were 850 of you guys who set your list public (in-game).
Pretty sure most of you thought it was Steam's public settings - So I've changed the terminology to 'Shared In-Game' and the public list is now 'Shared Lists'.

If you want to re-share your list, you'll have to set it again.
- NOTE - If you share your list, everyone who plays Game Quest will be able to play your list and compete in your list's leaderboard

notes.title: Font for names now supports all languages! (Including Russian cyrillic)
notes.content:
Now you can actually see the names in the public tab!
and omg, this game seems to be popping off in Russia and Central Asia!

Also fixed a bug that sometimes occurred when loading a public list, keep the bug posts coming! if you find one, best to post it in the discord as it is easier to manage than the Steam forum.

Thanks for all your support!

notes.title: Changed default Screen mode to Fullscreen Windowed
notes.content:
also, default resolution is now 1920x1080, this is to hopefully fix a bug a few people were getting
- moved gfx settings to a cleaner settings section of the menu

notes.title: Enabled Shadows
notes.content: TODO before demo build: option for users to disable shadows.

notes.title: New Player Character!
notes.content:
By popular demand, the hipster manbun soy latte guy with fancy shoes is no longer around.
Enter, cubehead guy with a hoodie!

notes.title: Ragdoll Physics on death! yay!
notes.content:
and after you see yourself flying into the sky, you get a nice zoomup of the game that killed out
- it needs a bit more work, but it still looks cool

notes.title: Controller Glyphs display in realtime!
notes.content:
- Glyph icons in the HUD and Menu swap to playstation/xbox/other controller types and back to KBM whenever a key is pressed on the specified device
- Removed collision sounds when hitting spectators

notes.title: New UI for deploying Allies
notes.content: Friend of mine didn't know about this feature, so now it's very noticeable (after you first encounter your allies and respawn)

notes.title: Audio is now directional
notes.content:
- Directional audio setup on audio (enemy ows, explosions, wing flapping)
- Loading sound (enemy spawn) pitch now changes according to metacritic score (when above 80) to alert the player to a flying enemy spawns
- Spectators can no longer be killed by normal attacks (as it was before)

notes.title: Added Screenmodes (Fullscreen, Borderless, Windowed)
notes.content: as it says in the title.

notes.title: Stronger enemies now build up their attack - Added flapping sounds
notes.content:
- Added flapping sounds to flying enemies (speed of animation is now tied to cost of game, to add variability)
- All enemies now build up their attack (lean backwards) before attacking. Weak enemies do it so fast you don't notice.

notes.title: Combat system tweaks (and other small fixes)
notes.content:
- Expanded keyboard hitbox
- Collision now includes entire animation length
- Increased delay before attacking again (to reduce spam attacking)
- Power attack now immediately raises keyboard, red glow is when power attack is activated
- Added camera shake and red screen flash when taking damage
- Moved collision mini-explosions to the front of the disk (increased radial force)
- Boss insta-explodes when weakness is hit, again
- UI fixes for ultra widescreen resolutions
- Resolution list is now based on OS, not hardset
- Fixed bug where sometimes you can't get out of the menu

notes.title: Fixed end game bug
notes.content:
Sometimes when the boss is defeated, nothing was happening.
Also the boss is a lot harder now.

notes.title: Nice looking buttons - Controllers can now navigate the UI
notes.content: Adding a bit of polish

notes.title: Proper Controller Support!
notes.content:
Instead of just getting steam to auto map keyboard controls, there is now native support for controllers!

Which means shift will no longer lock on to enemies when playing KBM! Yay!

UI navigation also works with controllers (please report any bugs with this though!)

notes.title: Monolith optimisations
notes.content: yeah it was eating too many frames. It now ignores lighting and shadows.

notes.title: Improved Keyboard Collisions with Enemies
notes.content:
- Standard keyboard attacks now impact enemies more often (on-overlap instead of on-hit)
- Changed player collision block radius with enemies, to prevent enemies from getting too close (under the keyboard)

notes.title: Optimised server-side database code, loading (after initial load) is quicker
notes.content: - Allows for users with far too many games

notes.title: Added gfx quality scaling and resolution
notes.content: Can be adjusted from the menu, basic UE5 gfx profile scaling settings: Low, Medium, High, Epic

notes.title: Boss is no longer immortal - but has a shield
notes.content:
- boss has a crazy amount of HP
- boss's shield goes down while it attacks
- still has a weak spot
- there is now an audio hint on first death by the boss as to where the weakness is

notes.title: You can now play non-friend game lists! (if they set their list to public)
notes.content:
Game List section now has two tabs, Friends and Public
Added button to set your list to public (should be good for streamers)
Added Leaderboard and your most recent attempts to each game list
You now preview a user's list before changing to it (to get a summary / check if theyre public on steam)

notes.title: Fixed crashes for people with too many games
notes.content:
Aligned spectators and royalty better
Royalty now ordered by most expensive at the bottom, so you can see them better

notes.title: Fixed attack bugs and glitches
notes.content:
Animations no longer re-socket items when swapping weapons too quickly (weapons would float)
Fixed bug where attacking and swapping weapons too quickly would disable the keyboard attack

notes.title: Added price tag to disk material - added various polish
notes.content:
Added price tag embedded into disk material
Added stopwatch behind the playtime text embedded into disk material
Added 5sec pause after defeating boss, for dramatic pause before the end game popup
Various polish

notes.title: Power keyboard attack is now consistent and requires power
notes.content:
To collect power, you need to do damage.
Believe me, now that the AoE dmg is working properly, it is far too OP to have as an unlimited move.

notes.title: Fixed floor texture scaling, added foliage
notes.content:
Fixed floor texture scaling (attempted nanite displacement, but it lags too much)
spectator stands no longer look basic
added foliage
Removed delay between enemy death and explosion

notes.title: Enemies can now climb the stairs, less likely to get stuck
notes.content:
No longer can you game the system by using the power attack at height
Sometimes enemy games will now jump on top of your keyboard, is this a bug or feature? nobody knows.

notes.title: Game Logos now download in background - Fixed Camera bug/Various other bug fixes
notes.content:
- Game Logos now download in background 
- Games no longer block camera collision channel (it won't zoom in when a game blocks vision)
- Other bugs that I've forgotten to mention

notes.title: Added collision effects and enemy projectile trails - Various bug fixes
notes.content:
A Poison trail and explosion is now added to enemy projectile collisions
Rubble now comes off enemies in their colour when hit
Rubble on ground no longer gets enemies stuck (they can now move it around)
Logos now show in full colour, no dithering
Damage inflicted now shows up temporarily within enemy health bar

notes.title: Games now have logos!
notes.content: Pre-caches logos to local disk, for all games.

notes.title: Fixed Game Over Crash Bug
notes.content:
Issue was non encoded url parameters, namely, spaces in steam names when sending data back to the server.

it now encodes correctly before sending.

notes.title: Fixed Attack Animations! For now anyway
notes.content: It looks a bit more natural now

notes.content: Added Music and Credits

Display powerup radius
setup coloured materials for different game explosions
